All web service requests require an API key to identify requests.
Developers should request a distinct API key for each application they build.
All users of an application shall use their own API key.
The API key is set using the api_key variable, a 32 character lower-cased alpha-numeric string.
api_key=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456 &search_text=canada Note that API key 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456' is for demonstration purposes only.
Use one of your registered API keys instead.
